l.i: Gens qua forte regi cuncta putat vaga, Demens ancipiti concutitur metu Quum rerum dubios prospicit exitus.
Sed summum æthereis sedibus Optimi Regnare arbitrium credidimus Patris. Hic certum genitis auxilium feret: Hic larga tribuet quod satis est manu.
Nil provisa iuvat copia divites, Si deest Superi gratia Numinis. Si præsens placido lumine recreat Detestata nihil pauperies nocet.
Hinc pectus trepidis intrepidum gerit Rebus, qui sceleris purus & integer Vita, rite tuum supplice dextera Numen, summe pater, quod colit, invocat.

page.notes: The verse uses a long s, which is shown here as a plain s. The u/v and i/j spellings were normalised as instructed. The printed "ct" ligature in "cuncta" and "pectus" was read as ct.
